quote: Text Generation We use the SVAMP dataset which consists of English math word problems ... Text-to-Image Generation We consider two subtasks: style generation and subject generation.
...We use the SVAMP dataset (Patel et al., 2021) which consists of English math word problems... for text generation...
We use Llama-2-13B-chat and Llama-3-8B model for the text generation and stable-diffusion-v1.5 model for text-to-image generation tasks.
datasets: Style generation datasets (Cartoons, Pixel-art, Line sketches)
outputs: Generated text for math word problems; generated images from text prompts

quote: We adopt the Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) as the evaluation metric, which measures the probability that a randomly selected mislabeled sample receives a higher influence score than a clean sample.
